name: flashfx
description: Let Claude build editable motion graphics in your FlashFX editor (editor.flashfx.app).
long_description: FlashFX Link connects Claude to the FlashFX editor open in your own browser. Claude builds the animation with FlashFX's tools and measured motion recipes, you watch it happen and can change anything by hand. Projects stay in your FlashFX project list; exports go to your output folder. Runs on your own Claude plan: FlashFX never sees or pays for your Claude usage.
